title: Al-Muwafaqat fi Usul al-Shari'a
altTitles: The Reconciliation of the Fundamentals of Law
author: ash-shatibi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shatibi's argument that the rulings of the law are ordered toward the preservation of religion, life, intellect, lineage and property, and that the details of the law must be read in the light of those aims. The first part sets out the sources and the second the purposes of the Lawgiver, with the linguistic and legal reasoning that supports each claim.
historicalContext: Written in Granada in the fourteenth century, when the Maliki school of al-Andalus was under pressure and reformist argument was sharp. The Muwafaqat was slow to circulate but became foundational for later theories of the objectives of the law (maqasid) and is now read across the schools.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
